Rules say same-entity, and for same-entity, best value... For same-entity name drift, best value should be the cleaner/correct one. The document's "Co., Ltd" is the standard legal suffix form; the register's "C.o. Ltd" appears to be a typo. So best_value = document's value.

Verdict: same-entity. Why: identical company name with only punctuation/suffix formatting drift ("C.o. Ltd" vs "Co., Ltd").
